title: cyclosorus canescens
intro: Cyclosorus canescens, commonly known as the Himalayan polypody, is a type of fern native to the Himalayan region. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus canescens include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
